title: [YSQL] INSERT ON CONFLICT batching RETURNING garbage
body:
Jira Link: [DB-15132](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-15132)
### Description

With INSERT ON CONFLICT read batching enabled and a RETURNING clause that returns non-ptr types such as text, the memory that it's pointing to gets invalidated so that the return output is garbage.  The data inserted is fine at least.

```sql
SET yb_insert_on_conflict_read_batch_size = 1024;
create table texts (i int, t text, unique (t));
insert into texts values (1, 'hello world') on conflict do nothing returning *;
```

causes, for example,

```
 i |                                                                                                                            t                                                     
                                                                        
---+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | \x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\
x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F\x7F
(1 row)
```

Applying this patch avoids the issue

```diff
diff --git i/src/postgres/src/backend/executor/nodeModifyTable.c w/src/postgres/src/backend/executor/nodeModifyTable.c
index 8af3dae274a..7e4c5f44dc9 100644
--- i/src/postgres/src/backend/executor/nodeModifyTable.c
+++ w/src/postgres/src/backend/executor/nodeModifyTable.c
@@ -5582,8 +5582,10 @@ YbFlushSlotsFromBatch(ModifyTableContext *context,
             /* Restore scantuple */
             econtext->ecxt_scantuple = save_scantuple;
 
+#if 0
             ExecDropSingleTupleTableSlot(slot);
             ExecDropSingleTupleTableSlot(planSlot);
+#endif
 
             state->slots[state->flush_idx] = NULL;
             state->planSlots[state->flush_idx] = NULL;
```

Oddly, that doesn't give any tuple table slot reference leak warnings when running `./yb_build.sh fastdebug --gcc11 --java-test TestPgRegressInsertOnConflictBatch3`.

Discovered this issue by running `./yb_build.sh fastdebug --gcc11 --java-test 'org.yb.pgsql.TestPgRegressContribPostgresFdw#schedule'` with code setting `yb_insert_on_conflict_read_batch_size` to 1024 by default.
